<!-- Hero-Slider (vanilla, ohne Abhängigkeiten) -->
<script>
(function () {
	var hero = document.querySelector('.dm-hero');
	if (!hero) { return; }
	var slides = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-slide'));
	var dots   = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-hero__dot'));
	var prev   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--prev');
	var next   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--next');
	var nav    = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__nav');

	// Mit nur einem Slide: Steuerung ausblenden, nichts rotieren.
	if (slides.length < 2) {
		[prev, next, nav].forEach(function (el) { if (el) { el.style.display = 'none'; } });
		return;
	}

	var i = 0, timer = null;
	var DELAY = 6000;
	var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

	function show(n) {
		n = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
		slides.forEach(function (s, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			s.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			s.setAttribute('aria-hidden', on ? 'false' : 'true');
			if (on) { s.removeAttribute('inert'); } else { s.setAttribute('inert', ''); }
		});
		dots.forEach(function (d, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			d.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			d.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
		});
		i = n;
	}
	function stop()  { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
	function start() { if (reduce) { return; } stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(i + 1); }, DELAY); }
	function go(n)   { show(n); stop(); start(); }

	next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i + 1); });
	prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i - 1); });
	dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { go(k); }); });

	hero.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
	hero.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('focusout', start);
	hero.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
		if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  { go(i - 1); }
		if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { go(i + 1); }
	});
	document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { document.hidden ? stop() : start(); });

	show(0);
	start();
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {

	var i = 0, timer = null;
	var DELAY = 7000;

	start();
})();

<!-- Hero-Slider (vanilla, ohne Abhängigkeiten) -->
<script>
(function () {
	var hero = document.querySelector('.dm-hero');
	if (!hero) { return; }
	var slides = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-slide'));
	var dots   = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-hero__dot'));
	var prev   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--prev');
	var next   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--next');
	var nav    = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__nav');

	// Mit nur einem Slide: Steuerung ausblenden, nichts rotieren.
	if (slides.length < 2) {
		[prev, next, nav].forEach(function (el) { if (el) { el.style.display = 'none'; } });
		return;
	}

	var i = 0, timer = null;
	var DELAY = 6000;
	var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

	function show(n) {
		n = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
		slides.forEach(function (s, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			s.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			s.setAttribute('aria-hidden', on ? 'false' : 'true');
			if (on) { s.removeAttribute('inert'); } else { s.setAttribute('inert', ''); }
		});
		dots.forEach(function (d, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			d.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			d.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
		});
		i = n;
	}
	function stop()  { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
	function start() { if (reduce) { return; } stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(i + 1); }, DELAY); }
	function go(n)   { show(n); stop(); start(); }

	next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i + 1); });
	prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i - 1); });
	dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { go(k); }); });

	hero.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
	hero.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('focusout', start);
	hero.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
		if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  { go(i - 1); }
		if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { go(i + 1); }
	});
	document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { document.hidden ? stop() : start(); });

	show(0);
	start();
})();
</script>

<!-- Testimonios-Slider (vanilla, ohne Abhängigkeiten) -->
<script>
(function () {
	var root = document.querySelector('.dm-testi');
	if (!root) { return; }
	var slides = [].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.dm-testi__slide'));
	var dots   = [].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.dm-testi__dot'));
	var prev   = root.querySelector('.dm-testi__arrow--prev');
	var next   = root.querySelector('.dm-testi__arrow--next');
	var nav    = root.querySelector('.dm-testi__nav');

	if (slides.length < 2) {
		if (nav) { nav.style.display = 'none'; }
		return;
	}

	var i = 0, timer = null;
	var DELAY = 7000;
	var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

	function show(n) {
		n = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
		slides.forEach(function (p, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			p.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			p.setAttribute('aria-hidden', on ? 'false' : 'true');
			if (on) { p.removeAttribute('inert'); } else { p.setAttribute('inert', ''); }
		});
		dots.forEach(function (d, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			d.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			d.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
		});
		i = n;
	}
	function stop()  { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
	function start() { if (reduce) { return; } stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(i + 1); }, DELAY); }
	function go(n)   { show(n); stop(); start(); }

	if (next) { next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i + 1); }); }
	if (prev) { prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i - 1); }); }
	dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { go(k); }); });

	root.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
	root.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
	root.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
	root.addEventListener('focusout', start);
	document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { document.hidden ? stop() : start(); });

	show(0);
	start();
})();
</script>

<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Our Tree Initiative with PLANT-MY-TREE and IMPACT HERO!</h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Since 2019, we have donated one tree for every customer each year. We also offset our own annual CO² emissions through a donation.</p>



<p class="dm-baum__motto wp-block-paragraph"><em>“Every tree counts.”</em> True to this motto, as a domain provider we want to contribute to environmental protection and encourage others to leave behind a world worth living in for future generations. To do this, we rely on strong partners.</p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Since 2009, PLANT-MY-TREE has been running reforestation projects for CO² offsetting across Germany. Our shared goal is environmental and climate protection in Germany, right where the CO² emissions occur.</p>

<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Impact Hero is an impact-tech company based in Berlin. <!-- Hero-Slider (vanilla, ohne Abhängigkeiten) -->
<script>
(function () {
	var hero = document.querySelector('.dm-hero');
	if (!hero) { return; }
	var slides = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-slide'));
	var dots   = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-hero__dot'));
	var prev   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--prev');
	var next   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--next');
	var nav    = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__nav');

	// Mit nur einem Slide: Steuerung ausblenden, nichts rotieren.
	if (slides.length < 2) {
		[prev, next, nav].forEach(function (el) { if (el) { el.style.display = 'none'; } });
		return;
	}

	var i = 0, timer = null;
	var DELAY = 6000;
	var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

	function show(n) {
		n = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
		slides.forEach(function (s, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			s.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			s.setAttribute('aria-hidden', on ? 'false' : 'true');
			if (on) { s.removeAttribute('inert'); } else { s.setAttribute('inert', ''); }
		});
		dots.forEach(function (d, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			d.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			d.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
		});
		i = n;
	}
	function stop()  { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
	function start() { if (reduce) { return; } stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(i + 1); }, DELAY); }
	function go(n)   { show(n); stop(); start(); }

	next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i + 1); });
	prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i - 1); });
	dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { go(k); }); });

	hero.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
	hero.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('focusout', start);
	hero.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
		if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  { go(i - 1); }
		if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { go(i + 1); }
	});
	document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { document.hidden ? stop() : start(); });

	show(0);
	start();
})();
</script>

<!-- Testimonios-Slider (vanilla, ohne Abhängigkeiten) -->
<script>
(function () {
	var root = document.querySelector('.dm-testi');
	if (!root) { return; }
	var slides = [].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.dm-testi__slide'));
	var dots   = [].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.dm-testi__dot'));
	var prev   = root.querySelector('.dm-testi__arrow--prev');
	var next   = root.querySelector('.dm-testi__arrow--next');
	var nav    = root.querySelector('.dm-testi__nav');

	if (slides.length < 2) {
		if (nav) { nav.style.display = 'none'; }
		return;
	}

	var i = 0, timer = null;
	var DELAY = 7000;
	var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

	function show(n) {
		n = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
		slides.forEach(function (p, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			p.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			p.setAttribute('aria-hidden', on ? 'false' : 'true');
			if (on) { p.removeAttribute('inert'); } else { p.setAttribute('inert', ''); }
		});
		dots.forEach(function (d, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			d.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			d.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
		});
		i = n;
	}
	function stop()  { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
	function start() { if (reduce) { return; } stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(i + 1); }, DELAY); }
	function go(n)   { show(n); stop(); start(); }

	if (next) { next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i + 1); }); }
	if (prev) { prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i - 1); }); }
	dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { go(k); }); });

	root.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
	root.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
	root.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
	root.addEventListener('focusout', start);

	show(0);
	start();
})();
</script>

<!-- Hero-Slider (vanilla, ohne Abhängigkeiten) -->
<script>
(function () {
	var hero = document.querySelector('.dm-hero');
	if (!hero) { return; }
	var slides = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-slide'));
	var dots   = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-hero__dot'));
	var prev   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--prev');
	var next   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--next');
	var nav    = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__nav');

	// Mit nur einem Slide: Steuerung ausblenden, nichts rotieren.
	if (slides.length < 2) {
		[prev, next, nav].forEach(function (el) { if (el) { el.style.display = 'none'; } });
		return;
	}

	var i = 0, timer = null;
	var DELAY = 6000;
	var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

	function show(n) {
		n = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
		slides.forEach(function (s, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			s.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			s.setAttribute('aria-hidden', on ? 'false' : 'true');
			if (on) { s.removeAttribute('inert'); } else { s.setAttribute('inert', ''); }
		});
		dots.forEach(function (d, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			d.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			d.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
		});
		i = n;
	}
	function stop()  { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
	function start() { if (reduce) { return; } stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(i + 1); }, DELAY); }
	function go(n)   { show(n); stop(); start(); }

	next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i + 1); });
	prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i - 1); });
	dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { go(k); }); });

	hero.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
	hero.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('focusout', start);
	hero.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
		if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  { go(i - 1); }
		if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { go(i + 1); }
	});
	document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { document.hidden ? stop() : start(); });

	show(0);
	start();
})();
</script>

<!-- Hero-Slider (vanilla, ohne Abhängigkeiten) -->
<script>
(function () {
	var hero = document.querySelector('.dm-hero');
	if (!hero) { return; }
	var slides = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-slide'));
	var dots   = [].slice.call(hero.querySelectorAll('.dm-hero__dot'));
	var prev   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--prev');
	var next   = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__arrow--next');
	var nav    = hero.querySelector('.dm-hero__nav');

	// Mit nur einem Slide: Steuerung ausblenden, nichts rotieren.
	if (slides.length < 2) {
		[prev, next, nav].forEach(function (el) { if (el) { el.style.display = 'none'; } });
		return;
	}

	var i = 0, timer = null;
	var DELAY = 6000;
	var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

	function show(n) {
		n = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
		slides.forEach(function (s, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			s.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			s.setAttribute('aria-hidden', on ? 'false' : 'true');
			if (on) { s.removeAttribute('inert'); } else { s.setAttribute('inert', ''); }
		});
		dots.forEach(function (d, k) {
			var on = k === n;
			d.classList.toggle('is-active', on);
			d.setAttribute('aria-selected', on ? 'true' : 'false');
		});
		i = n;
	}
	function stop()  { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
	function start() { if (reduce) { return; } stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(i + 1); }, DELAY); }
	function go(n)   { show(n); stop(); start(); }

	next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i + 1); });
	prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i - 1); });
	dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { go(k); }); });

	hero.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
	hero.addEventListener('focusin', stop);
	hero.addEventListener('focusout', start);
	hero.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
		if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft')  { go(i - 1); }
		if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') { go(i + 1); }
	});
	document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () { document.hidden ? stop() : start(); });

	show(0);
	start();
})();
</script>

		});

	function stop()  { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }
	function start() { if (reduce) { return; } stop(); timer = setInterval(function () { show(i + 1); }, DELAY); }
	function go(n)   { show(n); stop(); start(); }

	if (next) { next.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i + 1); }); }
	if (prev) { prev.addEventListener('click', function () { go(i - 1); }); }
	dots.forEach(function (d, k) { d.addEventListener('click', function () { go(k); }); });

	root.addEventListener('mouseenter', stop);
	root.addEventListener('mouseleave', start);
	root.addEventListener('focusin', stop);

})();
